leads.claim: When a canvas or camera binds its keyboard handler on the container, decline any key that is already defaultPrevented, carries Ctrl/Meta/Alt, or targets an editable descendant, because the container hears every key typed inside it and otherwise eats text input, double-handles a child's roving key and swallows the browser's page zoom.
leads.because: cab6dd1: probe showed '-' typed in a field zoomed the camera and never reached the field, a roving list's arrow also orbited, Ctrl+= was prevented; an atlas surface had already worked around it with `event.target !== canvas`

leads.claim: When an overlay's focus restore is deferred to a later frame, resolve the fallback target (and the invoker's connectivity) inside that frame, not at teardown, because the surface beneath can rebuild the landmark between teardown and restore and a teardown-time lookup answers nothing.
leads.because: 26f8424: probe with the origin card re-created by an effect of the closing commit dropped focus to the body; resolving in the frame focused the card
